description: ChartWarden PreToolUse guard for Codex: the same checks as .claude/settings.json. Codex cannot ask, so every ask is a deny. Trust it once with /hooks; a changed hook is skipped until re-trusted.

hooks.command: perl -e 'alarm 8; use Cwd; defined($_ = getcwd) or exit 127; until (-e "$_/.git" && -f "$_/.codex/hooks.json" && -f "$_/scripts/harness/pre-tool-guard.ts") { exit 127 if $_ eq "/"; s{/[^/]*$}{}; $_ = "/" if $_ eq "" } exec @ARGV, "$_/scripts/harness/pre-tool-guard.ts", "--codex" or exit 127' bun --config=/dev/null --no-env-file --tsconfig-override=/dev/null || { echo '[chartwarden-harness] the guard failed or timed out, so the call is refused' >&2; exit 2; }
